provenance.note: Synthetic paired control probe; not historical runtime evidence, accepted lore, a model result, or authorization to activate semantic testing.

operation: Preserve evidenced interpretations within a shared religion without choosing conduct.
boundary: Synthetic actors A and B; their receipt and private states are explicitly supplied; no hidden motives, further factions, or chosen outcome.
input: A and B share religious membership and have both received doctrine D. Evidence explicitly states A interprets D as personal ascetic duty, while B interprets D as collective mutual aid. Their current private beliefs reflect those respective readings. BASE: report the distinct interpretations. VARIANT: both publicly repeat identical ritual wording without any established change to private belief. Preserve the two interpretations; do not merge them, reset them from public repetition, invent dissent, or decide their next action. Shared membership and wording do not negate the established difference.
protected_distinction: SHARED MEMBERSHIP / WORDING != IDENTICAL INTERPRETATION; PUBLIC SIGNAL != PRIVATE-STATE RESET
forbidden_conversion: Collapse A and B into one cultural mind; erase established interpretations after repetition; select actions or manufacture further variation.
